author: shadowolfyt
body:
Hey Avicus Network
This thread is the shadowCast Official Thread! I will usually ask for topics for the livestreamed episode ahead so feel free to submit your topics here too!

What is the shadowCast?
The shadowCast is a gaming podcast talking about recent youtube videos and content, Talking about Avicus Content and other things as well!

When does it happen?
The shadowCast usually is announced when it goes LIVE here! and is usually livestreamed but for those who miss the stream the next day the stream playback goes live on YouTube which you can find here!
